title: Modified Samberg Phenol:Chloroform HMW DNA Prep for Plants
author: Alex Harkess
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.kpwcvpe

steps.title: Prepare CTAB Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare 50 ml of CTAB buffer (to be used within 2 weeks) by combining the following reagents and dissolving over low/medium heat with a stir bar: 5ml 1M Tris (pH 8.0), 2ml 0.5M EDTA, 4.15g NaCl, 1g CTAB, and 1g PVP; add ddH20 to reach a final volume of 50ml.

steps.title: Grind Plant Tissue
steps.instruction: Grind 3.5 g of young tissue in liquid nitrogen using a mortar and pestle.

steps.title: Add Lysis Reagents
steps.instruction: Add the following reagents to the ground tissue: 15 ul of CTAB buffer, 30 ul of beta-mercaptoethanol (BME), and 200ul NEB Proteinase K (800 U / ml).

steps.title: Vortex Sample
steps.instruction: Vortex the sample at full speed for 10 seconds.

steps.title: Incubate for Lysis
steps.instruction: Incubate the sample in a waterbath at 57 C for 30 minutes, gently inverting every 5 minutes.

steps.title: RNase Treatment
steps.instruction: Reduce the waterbath temperature to 37 degrees, add 50ul RNase A (20 mg/ml), and incubate for 30 minutes.

steps.title: First Chloroform Extraction
steps.instruction: Add 17.5 ml chloroform and mix gently on a rocker or inverter for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Centrifuge Sample
steps.instruction: Spin the sample at 3000 – 4500 x g for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Optional Chloroform Repeat
steps.instruction: If required, remove the aqueous top layer to a new tube very slowly using a large wide-boar 25ml pipette, add an equal volume of chloroform, and repeat the spin.

steps.title: Separate Aqueous Phase
steps.instruction: Slowly remove the aqueous top layer and divide it equally into two 15 ml conical tubes, dispensing very slowly.

steps.title: Phenol:Chloroform:Isoamyl Cleanup
steps.instruction: Perform a phenol:chloroform:isoamyl cleanup on each of the two conical tubes.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 volume of 25:24:1 phenol:chloroform:isoamyl to each tube.
Place on a rocker or inverter for 30 minutes, mixing thoroughly until the solution is very milky.
Spin for 30 minutes at 3000 – 4500 x g.
Remove the supernate into two new 15 ml conical tubes.
Repeat the phenol:chloroform:IAA cleanup (add 1 volume, mix for 30 mins, spin 30 mins at 3000-4500 x g). Note: the emulsion will be foamy rather than milky this time.

steps.title: Combine Supernate
steps.instruction: Remove the supernate very slowly and gently, combining it into a single 50ml conical tube.

steps.title: Precipitate DNA
steps.instruction: Precipitate the DNA using ice-cold ethanol.

substeps.instruction: Add 2.5 volumes of 100% ice-cold ethanol.
Spin gently end-over-end 20 times until a dime-sized (approx. 2 cent euro) precipitate forms. If no precipitate is visible, add 1-2ml of 3M sodium acetate.
Let the sample sit on ice for 10 minutes.
Spin the tube end-over-end another 10 times, very slowly, to further clump the DNA.

steps.title: Recover DNA Clump
steps.instruction: Recover the DNA clump using a glass pipette.

substeps.instruction: Fashion a shepherd's crook from a glass pipette over a flame.
Fish out the DNA clump in one piece and gently swirl it in a separate conical filled with 70% ethanol for 1 minute.
Using another glass pipette, gently move the DNA clump off the crook and into a fresh 1.5ml eppendorf tube.

steps.title: Wash DNA
steps.instruction: Wash the DNA pellet with ethanol.

substeps.instruction: Add 1ml 70% ethanol, flick the tube, and rotate end-over-end gently for 1 minute.
Spin at 10,000 x g for 1 minute to pellet the DNA.
Pour off the ethanol and prop the tube upside down on a Kimwipe for 10 minutes or until the ethanol has almost entirely evaporated.

steps.title: Rehydrate DNA
steps.instruction: Add 150ul of ultrapure H20 and let the sample sit overnight at 4 degrees C.

steps.title: Sample Homogenization and Testing
steps.instruction: Prepare a diluted sample for Nanodrop testing.

substeps.instruction: Using a cut-off 10ul tip, draw 10ul from near the bottom of the tube.
Dilute the 10ul into 90ul of ddH20.
Spin on a hula mixer gently for one hour to homogenize the sample.
Test the sample on a Nanodrop.

steps.title: Optional Salt Removal
steps.instruction: If the 260/230 ratio is low (<1.9), indicating salt contamination (likely from sodium acetate), perform a secondary precipitation.

substeps.instruction: Add 2.5 volumes of ice-cold pure ethanol to the sample.
Spin end-over-end several times slowly to let the DNA crash out of solution.
Repeat the washing and rehydration steps (equivalent to steps 19-20 in original text).
